name: Founding Farmers Tysons

currentProducts.name: Roasted Golden Beets, Fennel & Radish Medley

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: The current Tysons menus state that not all ingredients are listed, warn that the scratch kitchen cannot guarantee safety from severe cross-contact allergies, and direct guests with allergy concerns to staff.

summary: Founding Farmers Tysons' five current restaurant-issued food surfaces enumerate 224 breakfast, First Bake, brunch-buffet, lunch/dinner, dessert, coffee, tea, and nonalcoholic beverage products. The frozen catalog remains largely current, but six names were truncated by extraction, two rows are text fragments rather than products, and the current PDFs add numerous products. No official product-level allergen matrix was found; the restaurant instead publishes explicit scratch-kitchen and cross-contact warnings, so product allergen values remain accurately unavailable.
